name: Aboroth
description: A monster at Llanowar that Gerrard turns to metal pieces with the Thran Forge.

description_citations.text: "Rath and Storm". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight banks as an aboroth rises to crush a lone rider.
timeline.quote: The *Weatherlight* banked sharply as the colossal beast rose up to crush the lone rider.

citation.text: Aboroth (Weatherlight, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gerrard uses the Thran Forge to strengthen the aboroth, calling out to the elves.
timeline.quote: "This will work," Gerrard called to the elves as he used the forge to strengthen the aboroth, "but if it doesn't, we won't survive to care."

citation.text: Thran Forge (Weatherlight, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: An aboroth chases the Weatherlight until elvish war machines stop it.
timeline.quote: The monster pursues the Weatherlight, almost catching its sails when it is stopped by elvish war machines.

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section ""Tahngarth's Tale" ( Hannovi Braddock )". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gerrard defeats the aboroth with the Thran Forge and the Touchstone.
timeline.quote: Gerrard turned the aboroth into metal pieces with the Thran forge and then deactivated it with the Touchstone

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section ""Tahngarth's Tale" ( Hannovi Braddock )". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight crew defeats the first Aboroth in Llanowar by traditional means.
timeline.quote: The first one was defeated traditionally

citation.text: "Elemental", section "Aboroths". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight crew defeats a second Aboroth by immobilizing it with the Thran Forge and the Touchstone until it shrinks to nothing.
timeline.quote: the second one was defeated by immobilizing it with the Thran Forge

citation.text: "Elemental", section "Aboroths". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
